title: NFTokenAcceptOffer
key_points: The NFTokenAcceptOffer transaction type allows an NFT holder to accept an offer on their token.
The offer is represented by a unique OfferID that references the offer in the Offers directory.
If accepted, the offer price becomes the best known price for this token until it is updated again or the token is sold.
limitations: The scope of this document is limited to the XRPL protocol and may not apply to other blockchains or systems.
asserts: The NFTokenAcceptOffer transaction enables NFT holders to accept offers made on their tokens, using a unique OfferID to reference the offer in the Offers directory.
scope: This assertion applies to the context of XRPL protocol transactions and specifically to the NFTokenAcceptOffer transaction type.
